findings.current: With a sharp, startled gasp, the two barely evaded my attack and landed on either side of me.
findings.defect: The Hunters land in front of and behind Jin, not to his left and right.
findings.rationale: 내 앞뒤로 specifies positions before and behind the narrator.
findings.replacement: With a sharp, startled gasp, the two barely evaded my attack and landed in front of and behind me.
findings.source: 흡, 하고 헛숨을 들이키는 소리와 함께 아슬아슬하게 공격을 피해 낸 두 사람이 내 앞뒤로 내려앉았다.

findings.current: He’d covered up the murder of a powerful rival by disguising it as an accident.
findings.defect: The draft says he covered up a murder; the source says he eliminated the rival and made the death look accidental.
findings.rationale: 제거하고 is the act of eliminating the rival, while 사고사로 위장해 describes how that death was disguised.
findings.replacement: He’d eliminated a powerful rival and made it look like an accidental death.

findings.current: Even with death before her, she’d managed to slip a dagger through the gap in her broken armor. Her back arched like a bow.
findings.defect: The draft makes the gap part of the woman’s armor and leaves out that she drives the dagger into her opponent.
findings.rationale: 박아 넣은 describes her thrust into the armor gap; the surrounding exchange places her against Jin’s spear.
findings.replacement: Even on the brink of death, she drove a dagger into a gap in his damaged armor. Her back arched like a bow.
findings.source: 죽음 앞에서도 한 자루 비수를 부서진 갑옷 틈새로 박아 넣은 그녀의 등줄기가 활처럼 휘었다.

findings.current: Before the corpse crumpled like a rotten log, the reflection of a young man standing tall as an iron tower entered Michael Silbert’s eyes.
findings.defect: The draft turns ‘in front of the collapsed corpse’ into ‘before the corpse collapsed,’ changing a location into a sequence of events.
findings.rationale: 시신 앞에 locates the young man before the already-collapsed corpse.
findings.replacement: In front of the corpse that had crumpled like a rotten log stood a young man, tall as an iron tower. Michael Silbert saw him.
findings.source: 썩은 통나무처럼 허물어진 시신 앞에, 철탑처럼 우뚝 선 청년의 모습이 미카엘 실베르트의 눈동자에 비쳤다.

findings.current: A second Lee Jungryong. A second Go Jun. A second Michael Silbert.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Jin sees their counterparts standing before him, weakening the immediate identification of the Hunters he is confronting.
findings.rationale: 눈앞에 있었다 makes the comparison immediate and applies it to the people present in the scene.
findings.replacement: Right before my eyes stood another Lee Jungryong, another Go Jun, another Michael Silbert.
findings.source: 제2의 이정룡이, 석고준이, 미카엘 실베르트가 눈앞에 있었다.

summary: Four actionable fidelity findings: an altered killing, two changed spatial actions, and one omitted comparison.
